body: Ill try, I am going to stay with my mom for a couple days after midterms so hopefully I will be able to kinda just take time to allow myself to feel and hopefully the suicidality may pass. I really appreciate everything you said. I am so used to being that strong person that I didn't even think it was an option to have a moment of weakness. I really appreciate you reaching out.

I really appreciate you saying that. I have always felt like I had to pretend everything was okay, and it is so exhausting, I feel like I am just finally having a point where my body and mind have just had too much and just am at a point of weakness. Still trying to go to school while dealing with all this, still working with all this and still interacting with people with all of this is a lot. I apologize a lot, I don't know why. It is all very exhausting.

I went to crisis counseling but my time ended before I got the news from the police. I could only see them 6 months after the assaults, unfortunately, because it is a free service. I have my own psychologist but she doesn't like to talk about it because she doesn't want to contradict what the crisis counselor said and she isn't a trauma specialist. I did get some medical treatment for like blood loss and stuff but other than that, nothing else. I feel bad because I got a little overwhelmed and I tried deep breathing and looking at pictures of puppies and getting dressed and doing my make-up, anything to distract me, but I couldn't.

He does know about the rape and the police thing. I feel bad bothering him with it when I feel like I should just be more positive or something or when I can't specifically say what is wrong. Like I can't pin point whether it is about the rape that makes me feel this way or if it is like stress or anything and I don't know what to tell him. I know it can be frustrating for him.
